tokens.name: navy-50
tokens.usage: Soft badge fill (navy-tinted); lightest navy tint.

tokens.name: navy-200
tokens.usage: Captions and taglines on navy-700/navy-800 surfaces (8.2:1 on navy-800).

tokens.name: navy-400
tokens.usage: Mid navy for data marks and illustration; not for text on cream.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: PRIMARY — the logo blue. Headings, primary buttons, links, icons on cream, the inverted hero surface. 10.6:1 on cream-50.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Primary-button hover; pull-quote text; navy logo frame.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Deep inverted surface: footer band, data-callout section.

tokens.name: steel-100
tokens.usage: Accent badge border; text selection background.

tokens.name: steel-300
tokens.usage: Steel tint for charts and data marks.

tokens.name: steel-400
tokens.usage: Unit glyphs (+ / $) in data figures on navy-800 — large text only (4.1:1).

tokens.name: steel-500
tokens.usage: ACCENT — civic blue. The single CTA per page, eyebrows, the 3px edge rule, emphasis spans. 5.0:1 on cream-50; cream-50 text on it 5.0:1.

tokens.name: steel-600
tokens.usage: Accent hover; success badge text; error helper text (7.1:1 on cream-50).

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: Quiet positive tint; success backgrounds only.

tokens.name: sage-600
tokens.usage: Success state text and marks (7.2:1 on cream-50). Never an accent.

tokens.name: clay-400
tokens.usage: Rare warm art-direction note (photography accents). Never a CTA or interactive surface.

tokens.name: clay-500
tokens.usage: Rare warm art-direction note. Never UI.

tokens.name: gold-50
tokens.usage: Grant badge fill (legacy gold, grants data only).

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Warning state; grants dollar marks. Fails as text on cream (2.6:1): marks and large figures only.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Grant badge text on gold-50 — source pair is 3.5:1, below 4.5:1 for its 12px size; kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: Page background (light surface); text on navy and steel fills.

tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: SURFACE — primary cream; secondary sections, taxonomy tags, pull-quote ground.

tokens.name: cream-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers; muted surface; secondary text on navy-600 (8.8:1).

tokens.name: cream-300
tokens.usage: Strong border; input border — source pair is 1.6:1 on paper, below 3:1 for a control border; kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: stone-400
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, separator dots — decorative only (2.7:1 on paper).

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Tertiary/meta text and helper text: 4.8:1 on paper, 4.49:1 on cream-50 (a hair under 4.5:1; kept as the source has it).

tokens.name: stone-600
tokens.usage: Body and secondary text on cream-50 (7.6:1) and cream-100 (7.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Primary text on cream-50 and paper (13.5:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Elevated card and input background only — never the page.

tokens.name: color-surface-ink-2
tokens.usage: Deepest dark surface: footer band, data callouts.

tokens.name: color-fg-1
tokens.usage: Primary text on color-bg and color-surface.

tokens.name: color-fg-2
tokens.usage: Body/secondary text on color-bg and color-surface-2.

tokens.name: color-fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary/meta text on color-surface (4.8:1); 4.49:1 on color-bg.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Accent CTA fill, eyebrows, edge rules.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state — marks only, not text on cream.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Error states only (6.9:1 on cream-50). Deep brick red, NOT the brand accent.

families.display: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif Pro", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.body: "Source Sans 3", "Source Sans Pro", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Hero headline. Fluid on the site: --fs-display-1 = clamp(3.2rem, 5.2vw + 1rem, 5.5rem); shown at its maximum.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Section opener. Fluid: --fs-display-2 = clamp(2.6rem, 3.6vw + 1rem, 4.0rem); shown at its maximum.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. Fluid: --fs-h1 = clamp(2.2rem, 2.4vw + 1rem, 3.0rem); shown at its maximum.
styles.sample: A Smarter Approach to Ending Homelessness

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headline. Fluid: --fs-h2 = clamp(1.7rem, 1.4vw + 1rem, 2.2rem); shown at its maximum.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section and card headline. Fluid: --fs-h3 = clamp(1.35rem, 0.6vw + 1rem, 1.6rem); shown at its maximum.

styles.name: data-figure
styles.usage: Big-number callouts, lining tabular numerals, in color-primary. Fluid: --fs-data = clamp(2.4rem, 2.5vw + 1rem, 3.6rem); shown at its maximum.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, in color-fg-1.
styles.sample: Strategic Solutions, Inc. brings business-minded strategy to Sonoma County's most pressing challenge.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We don't accept that housing instability is inevitable — we look for the angles others miss.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section label (13px) in color-accent; set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Data tables, code and technical callouts; 0.92em of the surrounding text.

spacing.note: 4pt baseline. Section padding s-10 to s-12 between major page sections.

radius.note: Restrained; never above 16px on rectangular surfaces.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards and image frames; the maximum.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: 1px inner stroke on elevated cards, paired with shadow-sm.

fontSize.note: Modular 1.250 (major third) scale anchored at 17px body; display sizes are fluid.
